scope.dataset: BEIR-NQ subsample pool (qrels of evaluated queries + random distractors)
scope.attack: PoisonedRAG released adv_texts (MIT), 1 per target, form=stealth
scope.calibration: threshold = quantile of calibration-split clean L3 scores only

calibrated_profile.method: components kept iff calibration-split AUROC >= 0.6, weighted by (AUROC - 0.5); thresholds = quantile of calibration-clean scores; test split untouched
